# API reference

Every public type and member of `Cantrip.Core` and of the Godot addon's runtime scripts, generated from the XML documentation comments in the sources.

This is the reference. The guides are the place to start: [docs/csharp.md](../csharp.md) for a game written in C#, [docs/godot.md](../godot.md) for the Godot node, [docs/language.md](../language.md) for the content language, and [docs/troubleshooting.md](../troubleshooting.md) when something has gone wrong.

Nothing here is written by hand. `tools/api-docs.sh` regenerates it and CI runs `tools/api-docs.sh --check`, so a member that changes its signature or its documentation without this directory changing with it fails the build.
